crime: One girl often invited {WITCH_NAME} to join a group in the courtyard. {WITCH_NAME} waited for the others to laugh or speak before joining in. Whenever she missed a joke, the girl explained it after everyone dispersed. {WITCH_NAME} always returned the next day.

During evening free time, the girl performed impressions for the group. Her last impression was of {WITCH_NAME}: she glanced at the others, paused, gave a cautious laugh, and only then joined the conversation. Another girl recorded the performance on her phone. The group laughed hardest at that impression and asked to see it again at dinner. The performer agreed and walked away along a courtyard path.

The performer had not gone far when something struck the base of her skull. She fell and died. A small metal clothing fastener was embedded in the wound, far deeper than an ordinary hand throw could drive it.

The phone never stopped recording. Moments before the impact, it showed the fastener attached to {WITCH_NAME}'s distinctive prison clothes. It then showed {WITCH_NAME} walk behind a courtyard tree. No one else went behind the tree, and the performer remained visible from there along a clear, unobstructed path.

After the impact, {WITCH_NAME} returned without the fastener. A fresh tear in her clothes matched the piece lodged in the wound. The recording also showed that no one touched {WITCH_NAME} between the last view of the attached fastener and the impact, excluding an earlier loss or theft.

Behind the tree, {WITCH_NAME} tore the fastener from her clothes and threw it at the visible victim across the unobstructed path. She chose a lethal impact speed; her magic sent the fastener along a straight line with no time passing, driving it into the base of the victim's skull and killing her.
fields.epitaph: She had always spoken before the answer. At last, the answer came first.
execution: A massive iron ball hung from a long chain. She was bound upright with both arms behind her, leaving her no free hand or object to throw.

From the far side of the execution stand, the ball swung toward her in one arc, visible for the entire approach. It struck the center of her chest and caved it inward. Her heart stopped before the ball swung away.

magic.name: Zero-Time Throw
magic.text: An object she throws reaches its target with no time passing.
